title: Mongo-sharded: sharded topology (Shards populated)
description: Runs `nexus topology mongo-sharded`. Unlike the 0.G.2 replica set, this populates the Shards table: one row per data shard with its primary + replica members.

observe.what: Nodes table (config/shard/router roles) + Shards table: shard-1 + shard-2, each primary + 2 replicas, slot range = hashed shard key
JSON TopologySnapshot with shards[] non-null (2 TopologyShard entries) — the genuinely-sharded showcase

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.TopologyAsync emits a populated Shards array (one TopologyShard per data shard RS), distinguishing this sharded cluster from the non-sharded mongo RS (whose Shards is null).
